citations.title: Cadence Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

sentences.text: Cadence's senior leadership has been stable: the February 2026 annual report lists Anirudh Devgan as president and chief executive and John M. Wall as chief financial officer, alongside Paul Cunningham, Paul Scannell, Marc Taxay and Chin-Chi Teng, with no changes reported.

At board level, Luc Van den hove, the imec chief executive, was named a director in November 2025, effective 1 January 2026, and was designated to the compensation committee on 7 May 2026; Devgan separately joined the board of Lam Research on 3 February 2026.
